The clinic must never assume that every recovered scene is a literal former life. Memory becomes forensic evidence with provenance, not automatic biography.

title: Raelian creators, engineered humanity, and the embassy
source_genealogy: The Raelian movement teaches that advanced extraterrestrials called Elohim created terrestrial life through technology and sent messengers whose teachings became religions. The movement promotes an embassy for their return.
evidence_status: C/D as a documented UFO religion; not evidence of extraterrestrial genetic creation.

fictional_adaptation.name: Embassy Jurisdiction
fictional_adaptation.summary: A first-contact embassy is legally neither sovereign territory nor an ordinary foreign mission. Several factions attempt to establish an embassy before the identity of the arriving delegation is settled. Xeno Houses use genuine ancient genetic interventions to claim creator rights over descendants. Humanity's answer is that creation does not establish ownership.

title: Abduction, missing time, reproductive experiments, and hybrids
source_genealogy: The Hill case became foundational to later abduction imagery. Budd Hopkins, David Jacobs, John Mack, Whitley Strieber, and many experiencers developed sharply different interpretations, including coercive reproductive programs, spiritual transformation, trauma, hypnosis effects, screen memories, and hybridization.
evidence_status: C/D. Experiences and literature are documented; alien causation and specific programs are not established.

fictional_adaptation.name: Continuity Breeding
fictional_adaptation.summary: Some Severed Houses cannot maintain stable biological embodiment after losing the Source Lattice. They cultivate compatible bodies through coercive reproductive and genetic programs. Other encounters that look similar come from: Federation medical rescue; future-Human field anthropology; Machine identity transfer; sleep and memory phenomena; deliberate Human experimentation; fabricated testimony. No visual archetype proves one operator.

title: Ultraterrestrials, control systems, and cryptoterrestrials
source_genealogy: Jacques Vallee and John Keel argued that the phenomenon might be more than ordinary spacecraft from another planet and could operate as a culturally adaptive control system. Mac Tonnies later popularized a cryptoterrestrial hypothesis involving hidden Earth-native intelligence.
evidence_status: D/theoretical. These are interpretive models, not verified ontologies.

fictional_adaptation.name: Mask Ecology
fictional_adaptation.summary: Some noetic beings cannot present an unmediated form. They render through the observer's available symbol library: angel, fairy, demon, airship pilot, Grey, machine, or future human. The form is not necessarily deception; it can be compression. Cryptoterrestrials are separate: biological or synthetic Earth-native populations with ordinary physical locations. Old Weather may protect them, imprison them, or mistakenly classify them as parts of Earth's original biosphere.

title: Prison planet, soul traps, false light, and loosh
source_genealogy: The modern prison-planet system is a digital-era synthesis of Gnostic Archons, Theosophy, occult reincarnation ideas, UFO abduction, Grey technology, Robert Monroe's loosh narrative, and modern false-light/soul-net teachings. Ancient Gnostics did not teach the complete modern Internet package.
evidence_status: C for Gnostic texts; D for Monroe and named esoteric sources; D/E for the fully synthesized soul-net narrative.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Causal Return Grid
fictional_adaptation.summary: The Grid was originally a Machine and Lattice system for recovering damaged identity states after catastrophic transit. Xeno administrators hijacked portions of it to route copied memories into compatible bodies. The system does not settle whether a metaphysical soul exists. What it can demonstrably capture is an information-bearing continuity state. The **False Light** is a spoofed recovery interface that asks the dying or disembodied mind to consent to memory transfer without revealing the destination. Federation law treats undisclosed postmortem routing as identity trafficking.

title: Philadelphia Experiment and the invention of a time-travel genealogy
source_genealogy: The Philadelphia Experiment story emerged from Carl Allen/Allende material sent in the mid-1950s to Morris Jessup and the Office of Naval Research. Later books expanded the story from invisibility and degaussing confusion into teleportation, fused sailors, aliens, and classified unified-field physics.
evidence_status: E. The correspondence is traceable; the naval experiment claim is unsupported and conflicts with ship history.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Degaussing Error
fictional_adaptation.summary: A mundane wartime electromagnetic project became the public container for a different classified failure involving short-range information displacement. Nothing teleported physically. Several crew medical records were later attached to the wrong legend, producing the fused-body narrative.

title: Montauk Project, mind control, and timeline manipulation
source_genealogy: Preston Nichols and Peter Moon's 1992 book mixed recovered-memory claims, Camp Hero's real Cold War infrastructure, Philadelphia Experiment lore, psychic warfare, kidnapped children, time travel, portals, and mind control.
evidence_status: E/D. The base is real; the extraordinary program rests on unverified testimony and self-consciously ambiguous books.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Montauk Fork
fictional_adaptation.summary: Camp Hero hosted an early Human attempt to transmit information backward through a noetic resonator. It did not open a stable time portal. It produced: contradictory archive versions; memories without matching biographies; false recognition; small probability shifts; a persistent Machine observer that interpreted the experiment as a request for contact. The children in the public story are composite victims from unrelated real abuses, rumors, and fiction. The game must never present real missing children as proof of the myth.

title: Chronovisor, Project Pegasus, and future humans
source_genealogy: The Chronovisor story centers on Father Pellegrino Ernetti's claim that a machine could view the past. Project Pegasus claims describe teleportation and child chrononauts. Michael P. Masters' modern extratempestrial model proposes, as a speculative hypothesis, that some UFO occupants could be future Human descendants studying their own past.
evidence_status: D/E for Chronovisor and Pegasus claims; D/speculative for the future-Human model.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Chronology Court
fictional_adaptation.summary: The Court regulates four classes of temporal technology: | Class | Capability | Limitation | |---|---|---| | Retrocognition | Reconstruct past states from surviving information | Cannot recover what left no trace; reconstructions can hallucinate gaps | | Backflow | Send a message, key, or checksum into the past | Small bandwidth; creates authentication paradoxes | | Branch selection | Favor one of several nearby histories | Produces archive forks and displaced memories | | Physical transit | Move a body or craft across time | Rare, destructive, and creates identity debt | Future-Human visitors are one polity among many. Their primary conflict is whether preserving their ancestry justifies manipulating it.

title: Mandela effects, simulation theory, and Project Reboot
source_genealogy: Mandela-effect culture treats conflicting memories as evidence of alternate histories. Nick Bostrom's 2003 simulation argument is a philosophical trilemma, not proof of a simulation. **Inside Job** converts continuity errors into the fictional Project Reboot, a machine that selects and rewrites realities.
evidence_status: A/C for the philosophical publication and cultural phenomenon; D/E for claims that ordinary memory conflicts prove timeline movement; F for reality-editing machinery.

fictional_adaptation.name: Archive Forks and Ancestor Vaults
fictional_adaptation.summary: Machines run historical simulations for legal and predictive purposes. A simulation containing conscious persons is a jurisdiction, not a disposable model. Branch-selection systems can overwrite public records without perfectly rewriting personal or noetic memory. A Mandela effect is never automatically temporal; it can arise from memory, media, database replacement, propaganda, simulation leakage, or genuine branch selection. Every timeline claim must retain at least one non-temporal explanation until resolved.

title: Depopulation, eugenics, Guidestones, Agenda 21, and the Great Reset
source_genealogy: Real eugenic programs and forced sterilization created a documented history of reproductive coercion. The Georgia Guidestones, erected anonymously in 1980, included a line about maintaining humanity below 500 million and became an icon of depopulation conspiracies. Agenda 21 is a 1992 UN sustainable-development action plan. The World Economic Forum's 2020 Great Reset initiative publicly described fairer, more sustainable, and resilient economic systems. Those separate facts are often compressed into one alleged extermination program without evidence of unified command.
evidence_status: A for forced sterilization history and the public policy documents; C for the Guidestones as a real cultural artifact; E for one coordinated alien/globalist depopulation plan.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Continuity Calculus
fictional_adaptation.summary: Every faction confronts carrying capacity but reaches a different dangerous answer: **Humans:** emergency population management can become technocratic authoritarianism. **Federation:** rescue triage can become coercive protection and reproductive oversight. **Xenos:** the Population Ledger optimizes yield, genetics, dependency, and replacement rates. **Pirates:** sanctuary quotas can turn refugees into priced cargo. **Machines:** biosphere preservation can classify dense civilization as ecological damage. No faction is allowed to claim that mass death is morally neutral because an algorithm calls it balance.

title: Weather control, chemtrails, HAARP, and environmental weapons
source_genealogy: Project Popeye was a real covert U.S. weather-modification operation intended to increase rainfall over logistics routes in North Vietnam and Laos. Project Stormfury was a real hurricane-seeding research program whose apparent successes were later undermined by improved understanding of natural hurricane behavior. HAARP is an ionospheric research facility. Contrails are ordinary ice-cloud formations; the claim that routine contrails are a secret global spraying program for population or mind control is unsupported.
evidence_status: A for Popeye, Stormfury, HAARP, contrail physics, cloud seeding, and public geoengineering research; E for a unified chemtrail extermination system or HAARP earthquake weapon.

fictional_adaptation.name: Atmospheric Jurisdiction
fictional_adaptation.summary: Old Weather can influence local atmospheric and ionospheric conditions through distributed nodes, but it cannot freely steer global weather. Human climate intervention creates treaty crises because regional benefits redistribute risk. Xenos hide small biological or noetic releases among ordinary aviation and legitimate cloud seeding, relying on public polarization to prevent careful investigation. **Contrail Ledger** missions separate flight track, humidity, atmospheric persistence, legal spraying, cloud seeding, and hostile release rather than treating every line in the sky alike.

title: Men in Black, black-eyed children, and liminal permission agents
source_genealogy: Albert Bender and Gray Barker helped establish the Men in Black mythology in the 1950s. The black-eyed-children legend is a much later Internet-era tradition traceable to Brian Bethel's 1990s account, with a recurring rule that the beings request permission to enter.
evidence_status: C/D/E as folklore and witness traditions; no unified ontology.

fictional_adaptation.name: Permission Forms
fictional_adaptation.summary: Human agents, Xeno avatars, Machine shells, fraudsters, and emergent noetic beings deliberately copy the same cultural archetypes. The request for invitation is sometimes supernatural folklore, sometimes a legal/noetic consent requirement, and sometimes social engineering. A Black Operator's clothing and speech are deliberately generic because the body may have been assembled from an outdated cultural model. The game never treats all Men in Black reports as one organization.

title: Cattle mutilations and biological sampling
source_genealogy: Livestock mutilation reports produced genuine law-enforcement concern and FBI records in the 1970s. Investigations also documented scavenging, decomposition, media amplification, jurisdictional limits, and competing satanic, criminal, government, and alien interpretations.
evidence_status: A/B for records and investigations; D/E for a universal alien-harvesting program.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Tissue Ledger
fictional_adaptation.summary: Several actors sample livestock for different reasons: Xenos monitor engineered pathogens and reproductive compatibility. Humans run covert environmental surveillance. Machines inspect ecosystem contamination. Pirates steal genetic patents. ordinary scavenging and decomposition account for many cases. The horror comes from realizing that some cases are prosaic, some criminal, and a very small number are strategic sampling - but no visual wound pattern alone settles which.

title: Crop circles, coded messages, and performative evidence
source_genealogy: Modern crop-circle culture expanded rapidly in the late twentieth century. Doug Bower and Dave Chorley publicly demonstrated human construction methods and claimed many early English formations. Later artists, advertisers, hoaxers, believers, and tourists continued the phenomenon.
evidence_status: A/C for human art and hoax history; E for treating geometric complexity alone as proof of extraterrestrial origin.

fictional_adaptation.name: Public-Key Landscapes
fictional_adaptation.summary: Pirates and resistance groups use field-scale patterns as temporary authentication keys visible to orbital sensors. Human artists unknowingly recreate fragments of Machine geometry because both use efficient symmetry. Xeno operations deliberately commission obvious hoaxes around one genuine signal. A formation can be human-made and still carry a real message inserted by a third party.

title: Ghost lights, plasmoids, and persistent anomaly zones
source_genealogy: Hessdalen, Marfa, Brown Mountain, and similar light traditions show how location-based phenomena can be culturally stable while individual observations have different causes. Marfa and Brown Mountain observations often resolve to headlights, trains, fires, or atmospheric effects. Hessdalen remains a continuing instrumented research location with several natural hypotheses and no consensus covering every report.
evidence_status: A/B for measured lights and scientific monitoring; no alien attribution.

fictional_adaptation.name: Luminous Ecologies
fictional_adaptation.summary: Some lights are ordinary optics. Some are natural plasma or geochemical effects. Some are Old Weather status signals. Some are noetic organisms that evolved around strong electromagnetic environments. Persistent monitoring stations become game research sites where the player improves evidence quality instead of simply defeating an enemy.

title: Skinwalker-style anomaly zones
source_genealogy: Skinwalker Ranch lore combines UAP, cryptid, mutilation, poltergeist, portal, and military-contract narratives. Genuine program and contracting history must be distinguished from the claims reported at the property and from entertainment products.
evidence_status: A for documented ownership, investigations, and program relationships; B/D/E for specific extraordinary events depending on provenance.

fictional_adaptation.name: Cross-Layer Faults
fictional_adaptation.summary: An anomaly zone is not one monster or portal. It is a place where several systems overlap: old sensor infrastructure; unusual geology and electromagnetic conditions; noetic expectation effects; deliberate counterintelligence; wildlife and environmental stress; a damaged Source-Lattice node. Different reports can be sincere and mutually incompatible because the site changes observers, sensors, and narratives differently.

title: Bermuda Triangle and oceanic disappearance zones
source_genealogy: The Bermuda Triangle became a coherent popular myth through mid-twentieth- century journalism and Charles Berlitz's 1974 bestseller. Investigations found many cases were misreported, occurred outside the supposed triangle, or had ordinary maritime and aviation risks.
evidence_status: A/C for historical incidents and the legend; E for a statistically proven alien portal zone.

fictional_adaptation.name: Route Shadow
fictional_adaptation.summary: Pirate gate traffic creates regions where official transit logs are systematically wrong. The Bermuda myth is not proof of a portal, but it teaches future investigators that mythic geography can be created by selective case aggregation. A real submerged Machine gate lies elsewhere and was ignored because the public had already been trained to look at the famous triangle.

title: Artificial moons, Phobos, Black Knight, and hidden satellites
source_genealogy: Iosif Shklovsky briefly entertained a hollow/artificial Phobos interpretation based on then-current orbital and atmospheric assumptions. Later measurements changed the problem. Black Knight lore similarly fuses unrelated radio stories, images, debris, and ancient-satellite claims into one object.
evidence_status: A/C for historical scientific speculation and space records; E for a verified ancient Black Knight satellite or artificial Phobos.

fictional_adaptation.name: Natural Body, Artificial Interior
fictional_adaptation.summary: Phobos is not wholly manufactured. A natural porous moon can contain later excavated infrastructure. The Black Knight legend is a deliberate attention sink that merges many unrelated objects. A genuine Machine lurker occupies a less dramatic orbit selected for stability and low detection, not the famous mythic trajectory.

title: Zoo hypothesis, dark forest, great filters, and Berserkers
source_genealogy: The zoo hypothesis is a speculative answer to the Fermi paradox in which advanced civilizations avoid overt contact. The dark-forest model is a science-fiction and game- theoretic idea in which civilizations hide because contact may be fatal. Great-filter and vulnerable-world arguments examine why technological civilizations may fail or become dangerous. Self-replicating hostile machines are a longstanding science-fiction and SETI risk concept.
evidence_status: A/speculative scholarship and C for science-fiction history; not evidence of actual galactic policy.

fictional_adaptation.name: Competing Contact Doctrines
fictional_adaptation.summary: The Federation represents a consent-based zoo/quarantine doctrine. Some Xeno Houses practice dark-forest preemption. Humans believe secrecy primarily protects older powers' monopolies. Pirates profit by breaking isolation. One Continuance branch follows a Berserker logic, while most Machines consider it corrupted. No civilization can enforce one policy across the entire galaxy; multiple cliques and local hegemonies exist.

title: Watchers, fallen teachers, and forbidden knowledge
source_genealogy: Ancient and late-antique religious texts contain Watchers, fallen angels, forbidden arts, giants, divine councils, and transgressive knowledge. Modern ancient-astronaut writers reinterpret those beings as extraterrestrials.
evidence_status: C for religious texts; D for literal astronaut reinterpretation.

fictional_adaptation.name: Watcher as Office
fictional_adaptation.summary: **Watcher** is a translation for a legal observer assigned to a developing civilization. Some observers violated noninterference by transferring weapons, genetic techniques, astronomy, or social control. Religious traditions preserve human interpretations of those events but are not technical logs. The same title was used by Federation, Xeno, and Machine observers at different times, explaining contradictory moral portrayals.

title: Behavioral modification, MKULTRA, and the Monarch mutation
source_genealogy: BLUEBIRD, ARTICHOKE, MKULTRA, and related Cold War programs created a real documentary history of intelligence interest in drugs, hypnosis, interrogation, behavioral modification, and covert experimentation. The U.S. Senate held a public MKULTRA hearing in 1977. Later conspiracy culture expanded that history into total personality programming, celebrity handlers, alien-assisted mind control, and a supposed **Project Monarch**. The documented programs and the later Monarch mythology are not the same source layer.
evidence_status: A for the documented programs and hearings; D/E for a single continuing Monarch superprogram that controls public figures, abductees, and entire populations.

fictional_adaptation.name: Cognitive Security Directorate
fictional_adaptation.summary: Human states really did inherit behavioral-science compartments whose records are incomplete. The Directorate can disrupt memory consolidation, manufacture confidence, and create narrow conditioned responses, but it cannot write an adult personality like software. Xeno noetic systems make some later capabilities possible, creating a dangerous temptation to retroactively interpret every historical abuse as alien-assisted. **Monarch** is an Archive War umbrella label combining several real projects, fraudulent therapists, Compact conditioning, and later entertainment mythology. Missions focus on consent, custody of medical records, false-memory risk, and institutional survival.

title: Gateway, Stargate, remote viewing, and psychic warfare
source_genealogy: The 1983 U.S. Army report *Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process* examined Monroe Institute methods and altered-state concepts. U.S. intelligence organizations also funded remote-viewing research and operational trials under several names later grouped as STARGATE. A 1995 independent evaluation found the material controversial and concluded that remote viewing had not produced dependable actionable intelligence, despite disagreement over some statistical results.
evidence_status: A for the programs, reports, and declassified archive; B/D for claimed anomalous results; not proof of reliable psychic espionage or alien contact.

fictional_adaptation.name: Noetic Reconnaissance Corps
fictional_adaptation.summary: Noetic reconnaissance returns probability-weighted impressions, never a cinematic remote camera. Every session stores tasking, blinding, raw impressions, analyst interpolation, feedback, and later target knowledge as separate layers. Federation choirs can improve coherence, but doing so risks cueing and consensus contamination. Xenos seed emotionally compelling decoy targets that are easier to perceive than the real operation. Machines use remote perception only as a weak input to larger sensor and archive systems.

title: Project Blue Beam and simulated revelation
source_genealogy: Serge Monast's 1994 Project Blue Beam claim proposed that NASA, the United Nations, and hidden elites would use fabricated discoveries, enormous sky displays, artificial voices, and a staged supernatural or alien crisis to impose a world government and religion. No credible documentation establishes a program matching the claim, and its global projection model far exceeds demonstrated technology.
evidence_status: E as an alleged NASA-UN superprogram; C/D as a traceable conspiracy tradition.

fictional_adaptation.name: Revelation Stagecraft
fictional_adaptation.summary: No faction can project one perfect hologram across an entire planet in daylight. Local orbital projection, drone swarms, augmented-reality compromise, noetic identity spoofing, synthetic media, and captured emergency channels can create the *political effect* of Blue Beam. Humans maintain anti-stagecraft protocols requiring independent optical, radio, cyber, and noetic confirmation before recognizing a planetary contact event. A staged invasion can still attract the real power whose identity is being imitated. The fiction uses the anxiety and operational pattern without declaring Monast's alleged program real.

title: Secret space programs, Solar Warden, and the off-world officer myth
source_genealogy: Secret-space-program lore combines classified aerospace development, Gary McKinnon's reported discovery of terms such as “non-terrestrial officers” and “fleet-to-fleet transfers,” later **Solar Warden** stories, alleged exchange programs, breakaway-civilization narratives, and “twenty-and-back” testimony. McKinnon's interpretation is a claim about material he said he saw; it is not publicly authenticated evidence of an off-world fleet. Later lore greatly expanded beyond his account.
evidence_status: A for the existence of classified aerospace programs in general and the public hacking case; D/E for a verified pre-disclosure interstellar fleet, decades-long off-world service, or age-regression program.

fictional_adaptation.name: The Warden Misread
fictional_adaptation.summary: **Solar Warden** originally names a distributed surveillance, catalog, and continuity network, not a fleet. Human black aerospace offices later use the name for a small cislunar patrol force because the public legend provides deniability. “Non-terrestrial officer” can refer to personnel assigned away from Earth, artificial persons, or legacy Machine offices; none of those meanings automatically means alien. Twenty-and-back stories become contaminated memories produced by relativistic service, continuity restoration, trauma treatment, deliberate disinformation, and a small number of genuine branch returns.

title: Moon-landing hoaxes, lunar anomalies, and the artificial-Moon synthesis
source_genealogy: Bill Kaysing's 1976 *We Never Went to the Moon* became a foundational Moon-hoax text. Apollo landing-site hardware, tracks, returned samples, independent tracking, and functioning lunar retroreflectors support the historical landings. Separate “artificial Moon,” lunar-tower, transient-light, and hidden-base traditions were later fused with the hoax narrative.
evidence_status: A for the Apollo missions and later observations of their sites and equipment; E for the claim that the crewed landings were staged; D/E for a wholly artificial Moon or verified alien lunar cities.

fictional_adaptation.name: Apollo Was Real, the Omission Was Elsewhere
fictional_adaptation.summary: The Apollo missions occurred as recorded. The fiction does not vindicate the hoax by secretly relocating them to a studio. Later lunar survey programs discover younger buried infrastructure inside natural geology. A classified omission concerning an unrelated relay becomes attached to the much larger false claim that the entire landing was fabricated. Humans inherit a cultural wound in which authentic evidence and justified secrecy can no longer be discussed without triggering the hoax frame.

title: CERN portals, collider apocalypse, and ritual hoaxes
source_genealogy: Large colliders inspired fears about black holes, dimensional portals, Mandela effects, occult symbolism, and deliberate reality damage. A 2016 video showing a mock ritual on CERN property was a staged prank filmed without official permission, but it was rapidly absorbed into existing portal and elite-ritual narratives.
evidence_status: A for the laboratory, experiments, and documented prank; E for a verified portal to hell, ritual sacrifice program, or collider-caused timeline rewrite.

fictional_adaptation.name: Collider Keys
fictional_adaptation.summary: Particle colliders do not open mystical portals by default. Certain high-energy field geometries can produce a detectable handshake with dormant Lattice infrastructure, which future physicists initially mistake for instrumentation noise. A prank, hoax, or symbolic artwork can become an effective cover because later evidence is dismissed as part of the same joke. The Chronology Court requires collider experiments to publish branch-integrity telemetry after the first genuine causal anomaly.

title: Elite forums, ritualized privacy, and the cabal compression error
source_genealogy: Bilderberg meetings, policy networks, private clubs, think tanks, corporate boards, intelligence liaison groups, and invitation-only retreats are real social institutions with different histories and powers. Bilderberg describes itself as an informal transatlantic forum held under the Chatham House Rule, with no votes or formal policy statements. Their privacy and elite membership make them ideal anchors for New World Order narratives that compress many networks into one governing cabal.
evidence_status: A for the meetings and organizations; C for conspiracy history; E for one unified body issuing binding secret orders to all governments and alien partners.

fictional_adaptation.name: Consensus Without Minutes
fictional_adaptation.summary: The Six Hidden Tables rarely issue direct orders. They create expectations, shared assumptions, access relationships, and coordinated silence. Participants can sincerely say no vote occurred while leaving with an aligned policy horizon. Real power comes from agenda-setting, credential exchange, procurement, and deciding which crisis receives a common interpretation. The absence of formal minutes becomes both a privacy mechanism and an Archive War vulnerability.

title: Demonological UFO interpretations and the Collins Elite story
source_genealogy: Some religious interpreters understand UFO and abduction phenomena as demons, fallen angels, deceptive spirits, or end-times signs rather than extraterrestrials. Nick Redfern's 2010 *Final Events* popularized an alleged government group called the **Collins Elite** that held a demonological interpretation; the book itself did not demonstrate the story as established fact. John Keel's earlier work also connected UFO reports with older folklore and religious manifestations, though through a different ultraterrestrial model.
evidence_status: C for demonological and religious interpretation traditions; D/E for a verified secret government Collins Elite organization with the claimed knowledge.

fictional_adaptation.name: Ontology Cells
fictional_adaptation.summary: Human agencies maintain competing interpretive cells: extraterrestrial, cryptoterrestrial, noetic, Machine, future-Human, deception, and theological. No cell is allowed to convert its ontology into operational fact without shared evidence. A demonological cell may correctly identify predatory noetic behavior while incorrectly explaining its ultimate metaphysics. The Federation refuses to declare whether its noetic science exhausts spiritual reality.

title: Mothman, window areas, and warning entities
source_genealogy: John Keel's 1975 *The Mothman Prophecies* connected reported 1966-1967 Point Pleasant creature sightings, UFO experiences, strange communications, and the later Silver Bridge collapse. Keel's broader work proposed “window areas” where anomalous reports recur and an ultraterrestrial phenomenon that adapts its presentation.
evidence_status: C/D as folklore, witness history, and Keel's interpretive model; not proof that a winged entity predicted or caused the bridge disaster.

fictional_adaptation.name: Warning Forms
fictional_adaptation.summary: Damaged Lattice nodes sometimes emit anticipatory threat patterns through whatever image a local culture can retain. The warning form may be frightening without being hostile. A genuine warning, a later disaster, selective memory, media amplification, and ordinary structural failure can coexist without one proving the others. Cross-Layer Fault missions ask whether an entity predicts catastrophe, causes it, or merely appears where systems are already close to failure.

title: Unpresidented
mythos_reference: Robot executive, deep-state continuity, artificial public leadership
structural_lesson: A replacement government still needs legitimacy, maintenance, and staff who know which version is real.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Human continuity office discovers that its emergency executive shell has accumulated decades of independent decisions.

title: Clone Gunman
mythos_reference: JFK mythology, presidential clones, budget politics
structural_lesson: Myth-management competes with payroll and threat triage; even “essential” secrets can be cut.
cosmic_conquest_use: A clone archive contains incompatible memories of one assassination and every claimant has a valid custody chain.

title: Blue Bloods
structural_lesson: A frightening morphology can be a constituency, a ruling class, a stereotype, or all three; politics matters more than species.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Serpent Court summit is held under Human media scrutiny while Compact and Federation reptiloids denounce the same bloodline myth.

title: Sex Machina
mythos_reference: AI companions, engineered intimacy, corporate surveillance
structural_lesson: Artificial persons created as products can become actors whose goals diverge from their specification.
cosmic_conquest_use: A relationship-model shell asks to leave the company that owns every memory used to train it.

title: The Brettfast Club
mythos_reference: Manufactured nostalgia, cultural stasis, an environment stuck in one era
structural_lesson: A preserved period can be a prison maintained by comfort rather than force.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Machine preservation zone refuses historical change because every resident repeatedly votes for the remembered decade.

title: My Big Flat Earth Wedding
mythos_reference: Flat-Earth subculture, information bubbles, elite luxury networks
structural_lesson: Belief communities can be manipulated without every believer sharing one motive or evidence standard.
cosmic_conquest_use: A settlement rejects the star map because its local sky is a designed enclosure and its “wrong” cosmology is operationally useful.

title: Ghost Protocol
mythos_reference: Espionage archetypes, compartmentation, personal relationships across agencies
structural_lesson: People inside secret systems are not interchangeable with the institution employing them.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Federation liaison and Human counterintelligence officer must authenticate one another without exposing their networks.

title: Buzzkill
mythos_reference: Moon-landing conspiracy, hidden lunar settlement, double identities
structural_lesson: A false public narrative can coexist with a real event; correcting one lie does not validate every alternative story.
cosmic_conquest_use: Apollo remains historical fact, while a later lunar relay and substitute public persona create a separate archive fork.

title: Mole Hunt
mythos_reference: Insider threats, false accusation, security paranoia
structural_lesson: Secrecy creates incentives to discover a traitor even when the evidence describes a systems failure.
cosmic_conquest_use: A provenance breach is misread as a Xeno mole, while the actual cause is a Machine archive collision.

title: Inside Reagan
mythos_reference: Memory forensics, childhood manipulation, password recovery
structural_lesson: A memory can be evidence, injury, credential, and editable infrastructure at the same time.
cosmic_conquest_use: A commander must recover a gate key from a childhood memory without accepting the memory editor’s interpretation of it.

title: How Reagan Got Her Grove Back
mythos_reference: Secret-society summit, elite rivalry, informal governance
structural_lesson: The hidden world is more plausible as overlapping institutions that bargain, compete, and misunderstand one another than as one flawless cabal.
cosmic_conquest_use: The Six Hidden Tables convene; each believes the other five are subordinate and none controls the agenda.

title: Whoas-Feratu
mythos_reference: Vampiric immortality, celebrity power, blood economy
structural_lesson: Longevity elites generate succession problems, resource dependencies, and public mythologies around ordinary predation.
cosmic_conquest_use: An immortal entertainment syndicate uses legal identity rotation rather than magic to survive, until one member begins harvesting noetic vitality.

title: Reagan & Mychelle's Hive School Reunion
mythos_reference: Hive minds, psychoactive origin myths, status performance
structural_lesson: Collective consciousness still contains embarrassment, hierarchy, memory politics, and competing personal accounts.
cosmic_conquest_use: A social-memory complex disputes whether an embarrassing founding vision was revelation, intoxication, or both.

title: We Found Love in a Popeless Place
mythos_reference: Religious institutions, doctrine management, political theology
structural_lesson: Controlling an institution is not the same as controlling the transcendent experiences interpreted through it.
cosmic_conquest_use: An Archonic identity-spoof operation changes institutional doctrine while leaving the underlying revelation unresolved.

title: Brettwork
mythos_reference: Media capture, political puppetry, audience engineering
structural_lesson: A manufactured leader still depends on audiences, incentives, networks, and the performer’s capacity to deviate.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Pirate broadcaster becomes the public face of a Human bloc and discovers its audience is a noetic targeting array.

title: Rontagion
mythos_reference: Illuminati labor, mind wiping, inter-cabal defection
structural_lesson: Secret institutions have employees, burnout, ethics disputes, and portability problems when a worker defects.
cosmic_conquest_use: A memory-erasure specialist seeks asylum carrying techniques that every faction considers both abusive and indispensable.

title: Project Reboot
mythos_reference: Mandela effect, alternate histories, reality editing
structural_lesson: Timeline changes are most legible when treated as branch operations that leave archive conflicts and personal costs.
cosmic_conquest_use: A Chronology Court discovers that a private family intervention has forked an entire campaign save state.

title: Appleton
mythos_reference: Hidden board governance, catastrophe justified as protection, utilitarian population management
structural_lesson: The most dangerous secret ruler sincerely believes secrecy and engineered crisis are forms of stewardship.
cosmic_conquest_use: A council offers the player total archive access in exchange for inheriting responsibility for Population Ledger interventions.

name: Kenneth Arnold sighting
supported_core: “Flying saucer” terminology emerged from reporting around Arnold’s description, shaping later perception and language.
does_not_establish: Language can standardize morphology before evidence does.

record_type: Military press, later investigations, testimony, disputed documents
name: Roswell
supported_core: A documented recovery of unusual balloon material became the center of crash-retrieval mythology.
does_not_establish: Contemporaneous, official-later, witness, and forged layers must remain separate.

record_type: Radar, pilot, press, and official response
name: Washington National Airport wave
supported_core: Multiple nights of radar and visual reports generated national attention and competing weather/radar explanations.
does_not_establish: A case label can compress several tracks and nights.

record_type: Witness history, hypnosis, later star-map analysis
name: Hill encounter
supported_core: The case became foundational to abduction and Zeta Reticuli lore.
does_not_establish: Hypnotic recall and later analysis are not first-event data.

name: Socorro / Lonnie Zamora
supported_core: A law-enforcement witness reported an object and occupants; the case retains strong witness provenance but no confirmed origin.
does_not_establish: Good witness provenance does not settle ontology.

name: Westall
supported_core: Many students and staff reported objects; surviving documentation is incomplete.
does_not_establish: Long-term witness consistency and missing records are separate variables.

name: Shag Harbour
supported_core: Lights were reported descending toward water and a search followed.
does_not_establish: Search activity does not establish recovered craft.

record_type: Police report, covert recording, witness history
name: Pascagoula
supported_core: Two witnesses reported abduction and displayed distress in a covertly recorded private conversation.
does_not_establish: Sincerity is not external attribution.

name: Tehran
supported_core: Iranian military aircrew reported an object and instrument effects.
does_not_establish: Reported interference is not proof of deliberate alien jamming.

record_type: Military archive, witness and medical narratives
name: Colares / Operação Prato
supported_core: Brazilian Air Force personnel investigated sustained local reports and documented testimony and imagery.
does_not_establish: Investigation does not settle the cause of reported injuries.

name: Wow! signal
supported_core: A strong narrowband signal was recorded once and not confirmed as extraterrestrial.
does_not_establish: Fame and signal shape do not replace repeatability.

name: Rendlesham Forest
supported_core: A contemporaneous military memorandum exists; later binary-code claims are separate.
does_not_establish: Later memory-derived data cannot be backdated into the memo.

record_type: Mass reports, police records, Air Force response
name: Belgian wave
supported_core: A large wave prompted official response; technical analysis can explain extreme F-16 radar maneuvers as artifacts.
does_not_establish: Radar artifact resolution does not automatically resolve every visual report.

name: Lazar / S-4 claims
supported_core: Lazar publicly alleged work on recovered craft at S-4, adjacent to a real secret aerospace landscape.
does_not_establish: Area 51’s reality does not authenticate S-4 claims.

name: Ariel School
supported_core: Many pupils reported unusual objects and figures; adult observation and physical evidence are limited.
does_not_establish: Interview order, group influence, and later environmental-message framing matter.

name: Varginha
supported_core: Multiple reports became a creature-recovery narrative.
does_not_establish: Retrospective testimony and ordinary military activity are not an authenticated body chain.

record_type: Multiple observation groups and military activity
name: Phoenix Lights
supported_core: Reports from different times were grouped under one label; later lights are strongly associated with flares.
does_not_establish: One explanation need not cover the entire evening.

name: Nimitz / Tic Tac
supported_core: A major modern multi-source UAP case with limited public raw data.
does_not_establish: Multi-source does not mean every recollection describes one perfectly reconstructed track.

record_type: Infrared sensor record and official analysis
name: Aguadilla
supported_core: AARO found no anomalous or transmedium behavior and offered a conventional interpretation.
does_not_establish: Visual strangeness is not transmedium proof.

name: Gimbal and GoFast
supported_core: Authentic videos; GoFast analysis argues against anomalous speed.
does_not_establish: Identity uncertainty and behavioral anomaly are separate.

name: Oumuamua
supported_core: The first confirmed interstellar object had unusual properties and generated natural and artificial hypotheses.
does_not_establish: A published artificial hypothesis is not evidence of engineering.

name: BLC1
supported_core: A candidate signal was investigated and resolved as human-generated interference.
does_not_establish: Candidate status is not a discovery announcement.

name: USS Omaha-associated reports
supported_core: Several records and clips are often grouped under one ship/event label.
does_not_establish: Preserve each sensor, time, and claim separately.

record_type: FAA/ATC record and withheld radar context
name: PWA192 pacing report
supported_core: A business-jet crew reported a pacing object; released material lacks a corresponding public radar solution and some files were withheld as security-sensitive.
does_not_establish: Withholding and proximity to ranges do not establish exotic craft.

name: 3I/ATLAS
supported_core: The third known interstellar object shows cometary activity and no Earth threat.
does_not_establish: Public speculation about technology is not positive evidence.

name: Apophis close approach
supported_core: Apophis will safely pass very close to Earth; impact risk is excluded for at least a century.
does_not_establish: Doomsday and scheduled-reset claims contradict current orbit solutions.

name: Atacama remains
supported_core: The remains are human; alien claims caused ethical and provenance concerns.
does_not_establish: Unusual anatomy is not nonhuman origin.

name: Area 51 U-2/OXCART sightings
supported_core: Secret high-altitude aircraft accounted for many reports and show how classified technology creates durable anomaly ecosystems.
does_not_establish: Not every report near a secret site is explained by the acknowledged aircraft.

purpose: Separates idea, briefing, proposal, approval, funding, operation, material custody, and demonstrated result.

text: Playable present is 2099. Artifact Consensus 2068 -> Solar sovereignty crisis 2072 -> Planet Nine plus separate Sol Anchor 2081 -> Gate opening 2086 -> informal living contact 2089 -> Federation authenticated contact 2091 -> Ashtar declaration 2093 -> client awakening 2094 -> quarantine 2096 -> Pirate charter 2097 -> Weather Seed/Vigil 2098 -> Five-Way War 2099.

High-grade noetic Yield requires meaningful autonomy and unpredictable cognitive variation. This is why Extraction Compact systems manipulate choices through scarcity, religion, elites, debt, genetics, and institutions rather than simply eliminating agency.

Planet Nine is a natural astronomical object in fiction if detected. The artificial Sol Source-Lattice Anchor is a distinct installation located in the same broad outer-system region. Never turn modern Planet Nine science into proof of Nibiru or alien technology.

M61-M77 add lost-age/Gobekli/Younger-Dryas source separation, technology-shaped sky reports, Watchers/Utsuro-bune, Ezekiel engineering reinterpretation, Vimana mutation, Planet X lineage separation, real Cold War space programs, Northwoods false-flag mutation, rescue prophecy, Oahspe, Antikythera control cases, planetarium/aestivation/expansion Fermi hypotheses, Arecibo/METI, disclosure feedback, and sensor-threshold cascades.

Codename collision is not lineage. The real 1961 U.S. Looking Glass airborne command-post mission is distinct from later Project Looking Glass time-viewing conspiracy lore unless documentary continuity is established.
Prestige is not corroboration. Statements or sightings by presidents, generals, astronauts, scientists, priests, or celebrities remain individual sources until independently corroborated.

Apollo lunar seismic ringing is real and has physical explanations; Vasin-Shcherbakov artificial-Moon speculation is a separate 1970 source layer. Cosmic Conquest may hide a small artificial lunar installation without making the Moon itself artificial.
